title: fix(docs): move branding into the sidebar
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Docs branding moves from a fixed, full-width header into the sidebar above Search, using the shared Pollinations mark and a linked “Docs” label. Removing the header also removes its reserved 48px of space. Selecting a guide closes the mobile drawer after navigation, while section expand/collapse arrows keep working. The copy button moves up when there is no header and stays out of the way while the mobile drawer is open. Gen’s CI and deployment file checks now include changes to the shared brand mark.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and lavender tones and subtle CRT glow.
